headline.text: L3 Matrix feed magazine down *6 hours* on sensor fault — cleared 14:01 after bent pin discovered.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 1 ran caramel clusters with a damaged belt on Matrix 10 — scraper disengaged at 10:10 as workaround until replacement. Internet outage from 06:08 restored by 08:31. Sollich 2 saw elevated x-ray rejects at first inspection on second shift.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 had multiple PTL pressure trips causing three reheats on white chocolate startup, now holding steady at 16 psi. Flow wrapper fold issue on FFS required several adjustments through first shift, running clean by 08:17. ML3 ran without breaks.
per_plant_summary.L3: MFM pouch magazine stopped at 08:32 — bent connector pin found and straightened by 14:01, line back up. ML4 ran out of chocolate at 09:25 when PTL3 feed stopped, cleared in 6 minutes. ML1 Cavanna stops created remelt backlog, resolved. Internet down 04:38 to 08:25.

notes.text: Sweco screens for L1 mistakenly delivered to L2 maintenance shop, retrieved by end of shift.

resolved.title: Plant-wide internet outage
resolved.summary: All three plants lost internet between 06:08 and 07:03, blocking work order entry and label scanning.
resolved.resolution: Restored at 08:31 after Chad Stone called Tech Legion off-hours support.

resolved.title: FFS pouch fold at top and bottom seals
resolved.summary: Packaging showed visible fold lines causing quality rejections on startup after weekend cleaning.
resolved.resolution: Running clean at 08:17 after multiple fold box adjustments by maintenance; Alan Todd requested documentation of changes to prevent recurrence.

resolved.title: ML2 forming plate disks not spinning
resolved.summary: Disks stopped rotating after maintenance replaced dancing arm bolt, blocking depositor operation.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:37 — maintenance adjusted proximity sensor on dancing arm.

resolved.title: ML2 flow wrapper kicking out sealed bars
resolved.summary: Wrapper rejected all product immediately after forming disk fix, then intermittent rejects after restart.
resolved.resolution: Running normally by 09:45 after PTL reheated and pressure stabilized; some product still kicked during warmup but production resumed.

resolved.title: MFM pouch feed magazine belts stopped
resolved.summary: Infeed magazine stopped moving pouches at shift start, blocking all MFM production for 6 hours.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:01 — Troy Baxter and Nathan Ruiz discovered bent pin on sensor connector, straightened pin and reconnected, all functions restored.

resolved.title: ML4 PTL3 stopped feeding chocolate to depositor 4
resolved.summary: No flow to buffer tank, line ran out of chocolate and stopped depositing at 09:25.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 09:31 — Nelson opened and closed valve multiple times until flow restored, line running again at 09:59.

resolved.title: Internet outage L2 and L3
resolved.summary: L2 and L3 lost internet at 04:38, blocking warehouse operations and work order processing.
resolved.resolution: Restored at 08:25 after supervisors used phone hotspots to keep lines running, all labels saved for later entry.

resolved.title: ML4 aligner not separating molds properly
resolved.summary: Molds stacking together on aligner at 10 mpm, blocking demolding operation.
resolved.resolution: Nelson adjusted speed on Gondola HMI to 8 mpm at 07:03, aligner separating correctly.

resolved.title: ML4 cleaning roller 1 molds jamming
resolved.summary: Molds jamming together in cleaning roller area causing machine stops.
resolved.resolution: Nelson adjusted mechanism at 11:35, problem solved.

resolved.title: ML4 cookie stuck damaging chocolates
resolved.summary: Cookie wedged in line damaging product passing through.

resolved.title: ML1 Cavanna stops creating remelt backlog
resolved.summary: Multiple Cavanna stops filled one side of PTL with slow-melting remelt, other side full of chips, tank level dropped.
resolved.resolution: Chad Stone asked at 14:34 if Cavanna fixed, Imperial confirmed glycol good and all belts running correctly by 14:38.

resolved.title: MFM printer date printing incorrectly
resolved.summary: Date code misprinting on pouches after machine startup.
resolved.resolution: Line stopped, printer cleaned, issue resolved.

needs_attention.title: Matrix 10 C5 blue conveyor belt tearing at seam
needs_attention.summary: Small hole in belt reported at 06:33, coming apart at seam, scraper disengaged as temporary fix until replacement belt available.
needs_attention.status: Scraper disengaged at 10:10 per Eaglestone recommendation to prevent further tearing; belt still in use but damaged, replacement needed.

needs_attention.title: Multiple corn syrup spills in main warehouse
needs_attention.summary: Spills running from guillotine area toward S4 kitchen, active slip hazard.
needs_attention.status: Jorel Gourdin notified at 09:02, Charity requested caps for corn syrup hoses to prevent future leaks; cleanup status not confirmed.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 elevated x-ray rejects at startup
needs_attention.summary: First x-ray inspection on second shift showed high pouch reject rate, cause unknown.
needs_attention.status: Victor monitoring for follow-up at 15:26; no further updates by window close.

needs_attention.title: Security door to employee entrance not responding
needs_attention.summary: Badge reader door stopped working overnight, employees using alternate door that requires manual hold-open.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance checked fuse panel in Kathleen's office per Benjamin Hicks suggestion of 3amp blade fuse issue from prior occurrence; no final resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: Water softener leaking from top
needs_attention.summary: Main water softener has leak from top of unit, needs diagnosis.
needs_attention.status: William Lopez asked to help locate source; no update by shift end.

needs_attention.title: ML2 white chocolate PTL pressure spikes causing heater faults
needs_attention.summary: Expansion tank PSI climbs above 20 and shuts off heaters, requiring line bleeding and three reheats on startup.
needs_attention.status: Holding steady at 16 psi as of 09:53 per Alex Mendoza; Matt Hatch and Troy emailing PTL vendor for permanent fix, monitoring and bleeding line if PSI exceeds 20.

needs_attention.title: ML2 right coller splicing during changeover
needs_attention.summary: Film continues to splice when switching from left to right coller, requiring rethreading.
needs_attention.status: Line down at 10:43 to rethread, back up 10:46 but issue persists on coller changeovers.

needs_attention.title: Oil tote leaking in production area
needs_attention.summary: Recently placed tote leaking oil, possibly damaged from underneath during transport.
needs_attention.status: Brandon requested Joey Michael Dudney and Jovani Castellanos pull tote and inspect for forklift damage at 15:22; no confirmation of action.

needs_attention.title: Fire alarm sensor 172 HVAC fault recurring
needs_attention.summary: Sensor loses power and alarms multiple times per week, fire system company unable to find root cause.
needs_attention.status: Fire tech on site 12:53 to 14:12, suspects transformer tripping system; William Lopez to replace transformer and check low voltage wiring for shorts.

needs_attention.title: Warehouse leak on aisle LN07 location 29
needs_attention.summary: Evidence of recent water leak in warehouse racking area, not actively dripping.
needs_attention.status: William Lopez notified at 09:07, later mentioned finding suspected roof leak source at 14:16 pending confirmation before calling Superior Roofing.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG3 printer shut off on its own
needs_attention.summary: Printer powered down unexpectedly during production run.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 15:11, Chad asked if it stopped the line but no response; status unclear by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML1 centerlines out of spec on Imperial depositor
needs_attention.summary: Three centerline measurements outside acceptable range on one depositor.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 15:28 with four adjustments recorded outside centerlines; no corrective action noted.
